title: Mosaic Woman with Otter
description: A close-up portrait of a young woman with long dark hair, her face and neck covered in a vibrant mosaic of colorful geometric tiles. A brown otter swims beside her shoulder amid pink flowers and dark swirling background elements.
prompt: Close-up portrait of a beautiful young woman with long flowing dark brown hair, her face and neck composed of intricate colorful mosaic tiles in yellow, blue, orange and purple. A rich brown otter swims beside her shoulder. Pink flowers and blossoms float around her against a dark teal and orange swirling background, painterly style with visible brushstrokes.
